notes.title: V1.6.4.1 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where, in certain cases, the castle could not accumulate damage after exiting Endless Mode and then continuing the game.

Mods Issues
Recently, we received feedback from some players regarding abnormal issues with Mods. Upon investigation, we confirmed that there are indeed some problems with the Mods plugin. As a result, we plan to temporarily remove the Mods feature. We appreciate your understanding.

notes.title: Version 1.5.13.6 update
notes.notes:
New Content

 New card added: Toxic Dragon Turtle
 New enemy added: Saintess


Fixes and Optimizations

 Dogs can now prevent surrounding cards from being stolen by thieves
 The attack boost order for Mechanical Sabertooth is now the same as the Dragon Turtle's
 Reduced the number of enemies that insert cards into the player's deck
 Campfires now ignite bombs
 Fixed issue with spores automatically merging after splitting
 Optimized some text-related issues

notes.title: 1.5.9.1 Game Update
notes.notes:
Optimizations and Fixes

 Control the maximum cap for settlement scores to prevent the panel from freezing due to excessive scores.
 Fix an issue where the excluded coin count was recorded incorrectly when saving recipe plans.
 Fix an issue where card counts were reset when continuing the game.
 Added a display for enemy resurrection upon death at difficulty level 6.

notes.title: 20241117 Update
notes.notes:
Fixes and Optimizations

 Issue of stuttering on the main interface
 Fixed the issue where Dragon Slayer and Two-Headed Dragon do not interact
 Adjusted the attack power absorption value of the Overfiend from Imps
 Fixed the interaction issue between Kodo Beast and enemy skills triggered upon death
 Modified the Glutton skill to only affect food in the same column
 Fixed the issue where Challenge Mode achievements were not being triggered
 Phoenix Egg transforming back into a Phoenix now gains an attack power boost

notes.title: Demo Update Announcement - 2024/10/24
notes.notes:
Update & Optimization

Cards

 Fixed the bug with the effect of "Golden vs. Dragon."
 Updated the descriptions for Engineer, Enemy (Shaman Link), Wolf, and Wolfgang.
 Added an effect when Blademaster’s clones exceed the limit.
 Salt no longer affects other salt effects.
 FungiKing's card copy attack effect is now half of the permanent attack value.
 Wolf Pack's attack power now only comes from cards on the field.
 Fixed the animation speed of Crossbow and Arrow Tower, and the bug when there are too few targets.


UI

 The recipe display for the card itself is always shown as '?'. 
 Card descriptions no longer show the description for itself. 
 Added a '???' description for synthesis cards when the recipe is not unlocked. 
 Cards that cannot be selected in the card gallery are now shown as semi-transparent, with a quantity of 0. 
 Updated race icons.
  Shortened the duration of splash attacks and flying attack animations. Fast animation settings will now affect more animation options, such as enemy skills. 
 You can now delete multiple cards in a row, and manually close the window. 
 Added the shortcut key "Space" to skip the shop. 
 Fixed the issue where deleted coins were not counted in the score. 
 The score UI is now more prominent on the victory screen.


Features 

 Right-clicking now allows cards to be locked, preventing them from being used in synthesis; click again to unlock.

notes.title: 1.2 HotFix and Balance
notes.notes:
Suddenly players number go up and you guys help me find a lot of bugs...
I just fix a few bugs mentioned most

Bug fixed:

 Enemy Shaman link bug leading to game stuck
 Night Elf Ranger keeps attacking until game ends
 multiple click with Cleric adds damage multiple times
 many consumables has wrong counter mechanism like Dragon Blood, Beer.
 Victory screen display
 delete coin usage stuck during turn
 Character screen cant unlock new chracters
 enemy queen doesnt return heart when dead
 Gallery panel changes card pool does take effect now
 Some enemies' skill description of retreating to backline was added
 Difficulty 4 stuck bug fixed. Change the decrecated design of diffciulty 4.
 Make 5 queen loss simpler and straight forward.
 3 or more golems will only get 1 bigger golem bug fixed.


New features:

 Now cards attack order is simpler: from left up corner to right bottom corner, instead of ordering by damage and turn damage dealt.
 Damage Panel now shows extra info about real damage after armor.


Stats balance:

 PandaMonk, Lizard, Wheel, Bread and more stats balance
 Beer gain of Brewmaster is now temporary
 Duergar has a timer of 2
 Reaper's skill damage and Ballista's fort damage ignores armor
 'Dragon Blood makes Dog become Wolf' now changes to 'Dragon Blood makes Lizard become Green Dragon', and 'Bear becomes Wood Elf Druid' is fixed.
 Silver Sword now add 1 counter and 1 damage per buff


We'll keep up and make the game better. Welcome to Discord to chat :https://discord.gg/3mdkDpurNn

notes.title: Version 1.2 Big Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Enemy Skill System:
20+ enemies have their unique skills! You'd better destroy the fort ASAP, or the king would exile your deck!
Character Pick:
Player can now choose a character from these 5: Cleric, Commander, Recruiter, Sourcerer, Black Magician. They have different play styles and try to make synergy with your cards.
Improvements

 The whole stats system is reworked and balanced. Hopefully you will find the game not too hard or too ez. But still, feel free to come to Discord and tell us the cards you like or not!
 
 Weak build like poison are buffed (poison damage now ignores armor).
  Legendary cards are less important, they still need a good deck to release the full  power
  Try it out in the game!
 Coin UI Remake.
 Some VFX and SFX added.
 Attack Animation timescale reworked so low damage cards attacks faster and high damage cards slower.
 Heartlosing Mechanism reworked: you lose heart only when you have exceeded enemies at the start of a turn.

Bug fixed

 Tutorial display bug fixed.
 Sometimes players cant return to main menu.
